output: html_document

```{r}
library(mosaic)
library(tidyverse)
library(pander)
```

```{r}
View(KidsFeet)

```

```{r}
table(KidsFeet$sex)
barplot(table(KidsFeet$sex))
```

```{r}
mean(KidsFeet$length)

```

```{r}
favstats(length ~ sex, data=KidsFeet)

```

```{r}
mean(KidsFeet$length ~ KidsFeet$sex)

KidsFeet %>% 
  group_by(birthmonth) %>% 
  summarise(avelength = mean(length))
boxplot(length ~ birthmonth, data=KidsFeet)
```

```{r}
plot(length ~ width, data=KidsFeet)
cor(length ~ width, data=KidsFeet)
```

```{r}
boxplot(width ~ domhand, KidsFeet)

```

```{r}
mykidsfeet$season<- factor(myKidsFeet$season, 
                           levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Fall"),
                           ordered = TRUE)
plot(sex ~ birthmonth, KidsFeet)
```
